basics.name: GP Singh
basics.label: Cybersecurity Analyst I
basics.summary: Cybersecurity Analyst based in Vancouver, BC. Building security tooling with Python and AI — SAST/DAST automation, log anomaly detection, and offensive security research. Targeting Senior Security Engineer by 2029.

work.name: Cybersecurity Analyst I
work.summary: Security engineering and tooling development at a Vancouver-based organization.
highlights: SAST/DAST vulnerability triage and remediation guidance for development teams
Security tooling development in Python — automated scanners, parsers, and report generators
Log analysis and anomaly detection using rule-based engines and local LLMs
Threat modelling and security review participation across product lifecycle

courses: Memory safety exploitation (buffer overflows, heap, UAF)
Detection engineering and MITRE ATT&CK mapping

publications.name: Building a SAST+DAST Triage Tool with AI False-Positive Filtering
publications.summary: How I built a Python tool that runs Semgrep and OWASP ZAP, deduplicates findings by CWE+location, scores risk, and uses a local LLM to filter false positives — with SARIF export for GitHub Code Scanning.

publications.name: AI Log Anomaly Detector: From auth.log to MITRE ATT&CK in 30 Seconds
publications.summary: A Python tool that parses Linux auth logs and journalctl JSON, runs rule-based anomaly detection mapped to MITRE ATT&CK, scores confidence, enriches IPs via AbuseIPDB, and sends findings to a local LLM for threat assessment.

projects.name: P1 — SAST+DAST Triage Tool
projects.description: Deduplicates Semgrep/Bandit/ZAP findings by CWE+location, LLM false-positive filter via local Ollama, SARIF 2.1.0 export for GitHub Code Scanning.

projects.name: P3 — AI Log Anomaly Detector
projects.description: Parses Linux auth logs and journalctl JSON, detects brute force/escalation/credential stuffing with MITRE ATT&CK mapping and confidence scoring. AbuseIPDB enrichment and email alerts.
highlights: 7 detection rule types mapped to MITRE ATT&CK
Local LLM threat narrative via Ollama
